title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf Korea Pairing
items.text: Talor Gooch was paired with Bryson DeChambeau and Cam Smith during the third round of LIV Golf Korea on Saturday.

items.headline: PGA Tour Charles Schwab Challenge
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm gained leverage as the PGA Tour's Charles Schwab Challenge field at Colonial Country Club features only one OWGR top-10 player.

items.headline: McIlroy's Putting Advice
items.text: Rory McIlroy advised Scottie Scheffler in February 2024 at the Genesis Invitational to switch to a mallet-style putter to improve margin for error.
